title: Research on terahertz multitunable multifunctional absorbers based on graphene and indium antimonide
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14083-14091
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10034H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Baojing Hu, Changjin Cai, Ke Li, Weifeng Lu
This article proposes a dual-band terahertz multi-functional absorber based on graphene and indium antimonide (InSb), which can be electrically, thermally, and magnetically tuned.
